sections.title: Come a little closer.
sections.text: Nearlight brightens when someone sits close enough to whisper. If you leave mid-sentence, it dims the room and keeps a little light on where your face used to be.

sections.title: The room remembers.
sections.text: Over time, a faint amber stain appears where you tend to sit. It grows darker after long conversations. New owners inherit the stains and sometimes arrange their furniture around them.

sections.title: Give it a night off.
sections.text: Once a week, wrap the bulb in a clean cloth and leave it unplugged until morning. The manual calls this a cooling cycle. Owners tend to call it a little privacy.

sections.title: Keep the glow.
sections.text: When the lamp can no longer bend, its bulb transfers to a two-socket stand. It holds a dim copy of its last room. The second socket stays empty until another Nearlight wears out.
